issue: Source file is encoded as Windows-1252, not UTF-8 (the euro sign is the single byte 0x80)
resolution: The load step declares the true encoding. The file on disk is untouched. Verified: zero replacement characters in the raw table.

issue: Numbers are stored as text with thousands commas and leading or trailing spaces
resolution: Clean rule C3 strips commas and spaces and casts to bigint. DQ04 confirms no other text pattern exists, so no value was lost or guessed.

issue: One measure is split across two columns: euro amounts sit in Observation and counts sit in Number of Accounts
resolution: Clean rule C2 picks the column from the observation type, giving one value column. Rows found: 10832 euro rows and 8367 count rows.

issue: Count rows in the 31 March 2026 return also carry a stray euro-style figure in Observation (both value columns filled)
resolution: Clean rule C4 keeps the Number of Accounts value and ignores the stray one; rows are flagged corrected. Evidence: the kept values move a median of 3.3 percent against the previous quarter, whereas using the stray figures would imply a median move of 5152 percent. The stray text is retained in clean.stray_value_text.

issue: Reporting dates are the last working day of the quarter, not the calendar quarter end (19 distinct dates)
resolution: Clean rule C5 maps each to the calendar quarter end so a quarter has one key. The rule accepts a weekday up to 3 days before quarter end.

Mapped to 30 Sep 2025 and 31 Dec 2025 using the evidence stored in clean.reporting_date_map_repairs. This is an inference from the structure of the file. Confirm with the publisher before relying on those two quarters.

issue: Core measures missing for a segment and quarter: 2026 Q1 Banks PDH
resolution: Not imputed. KPIs that need a missing measure (arrears total, total outstanding) are blank for that segment and quarter. Dashboards must use the latest complete quarter for headline figures.

issue: Legal status counts do not add up to total accounts in arrears for: 2009 Q3 Banks PDH (difference -120); 2012 Q3 Banks PDH (difference 2935)
resolution: Source inconsistency. Values kept as published. No KPI is built on the sum of legal status counts, and the arrears total from the Arrears category is used instead.

issue: Euro totals differ from the sum of their buckets by up to 2 thousand euro
resolution: Rounding: each figure is published to the nearest thousand. DQ15 allows (buckets + 1) / 2 thousand and every comparison is inside it. Account counts reconcile exactly (DQ14).

issue: Arrears bucket scheme changes over time: 3 buckets to Q2 2012, 5 buckets to Q2 2019, 7 buckets from Q3 2019
resolution: dim_measure.harmonised_bucket maps every scheme to Up to 90 days, 91 to 180 days and Over 180 days, so trends are comparable. is_total stops totals being added to buckets. DQ14 and DQ15 prove no bucket is double counted or missing. Rows counted are the retired-scheme buckets.

issue: Possessions at the start of a quarter differ from the previous quarter end in 53 of 240 comparisons
resolution: Observation only. The publisher may restate prior figures or change definitions, so no rule or KPI relies on continuity. Recorded for transparency.
